title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: notes on alerts and cases
summary: The briefing passes: the note behaviour, limits, permissions and controls match Microsoft's documentation, and the release details match the roadmap. It correctly distinguishes the roadmap's launched status from Learn's preview labels and keeps unpublished note-specific billing and controls separate from documented product requirements.
